extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.11.3 - Setup wizard: add your streams and metadata addons and MDBList key step by step (Settings, or the skin's ... menu). v0.11.2 - Arctic Zephyr Stremio support: skin helpers, hubs, Cinemeta and streaming-service lists, its own context menu and info page buttons; Kodi's info page replaces Extended info and library integration is off. Kodi's Mark as watched updates your history. Continue Watching pages 20 at a time. v0.11.1 - Faster Continue Watching and Next Up (results reused until you watch something); smaller, compressed cache capped at 25 MB. v0.11.0 - New stream page: cards with badges, filter chips, no logos. Extended info for episodes. Selecting can open Extended info for episodes too. Fixed context menu entries overwriting each other, and settings buttons on Fire TV. v0.10.3 - With autoplay on: "Show Playable Streams" in context menus and a Streams tile in Extended info. Removing an episode from Continue Watching also removes its show from Next Up until you watch more. v0.10.2 - Continue Watching shows descriptions, cast and details.

extension.summary: Search your library, Stremio Bridge, YouTube and Spotify at once
extension.description: Type a search and see results from your Kodi library, Stremio Bridge's search catalogs, YouTube and Spotify (music and podcasts) in one page of rows. Put RunScript(script.shiggsy365.globalsearch) on any menu item or button to open it.
extension.news: v1.1.0 - YouTube results (videos; channels and playlists optional), remembered for an hour; or YouTube shortcuts instead. v1.0.0 - First release.

extension.summary: Choose which Dispatcharr source a live TV channel plays
extension.description: For IPTV Simple channels served by Dispatcharr: long-press Play/Pause while watching (or use "Choose source" on a channel or guide entry) to see the channel's source streams and switch to another, or skip to the next one. Dispatcharr switches the source on the server, so the channel keeps playing with its guide and channel info.

extension.summary: Keep Kodi's artwork cache and add-on downloads small
extension.description: Every few days, removes cached artwork Kodi hasn't shown recently and the add-on zips Kodi keeps after installing. Kodi downloads any artwork it needs again. Made for low-storage devices like Fire TV Sticks.

extension.news: v1.0.1 - Runs Stremio Bridge's setup wizard on first start; Setup wizard in the ... menu; fixed the ... submenu. v1.0.0 - Forked from Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded 3.0.3 (beatmasterRS, upstream commit 27b7bd7) and renamed. Removed the CJK font set (Inter CJK, 54 MB) to keep the skin small. No TMDb Helper or Embuary. Ready-made Home, Movies and TV Shows menus and hubs; Kodi's info page with Browse show, Mark watched, Watchlist and streaming-service buttons; actors open Stremio Bridge's person search; Stremio Bridge's context menu; a ... settings menu.
extension.summary: Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded, made for Stremio Bridge.
extension.description: A fork of Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by beatmasterRS, itself based on Arctic: Zephyr by jurialmunkey, made to work with Stremio Bridge, Global Search and Dispatcharr Bridge. Clean, minimal and light, with the layout of Reloaded. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, like the original.
Kodi repository for shiggsy365's add-ons, including Stremio Bridge. Updates install automatically.
